in_arabic.name: حذيفة
in_arabic.meaning: حذيفة يعني الشخص الذي يتم حمايته أو حفظه
in_arabic.long_meaning: حذيفة هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، ويعني الشخص الذي يتم حمايته أو حفظه، وقد ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم. هذا الاسم يحمل معاني الحفظ والحماية، ويعتبر من الأسماء التي تحمل دلالات دينية وروحانية كبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: حذیفہ
in_urdu.meaning: حذیفہ کا مطلب ہے محفوظ یا محکم شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: حذیفہ ایک عربی मूल کا مذکر اسم علم ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے محفوظ یا محکم شخص۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں ذکر ہوا ہے اور اسلامی ثقافت میں اسے بڑی دینی اور روحانی اہمیت حاصل ہے۔ یہ نام حفاظتی اور محفوظ رہنے کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हज़ैफा
in_hindi.meaning: हज़ैफा का अर्थ है सुरक्षित या संरक्षित व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: हज़ैफा एक अरबी मूल का पुल्लिंग नाम है, जिसका अर्थ है सुरक्षित या संरक्षित व्यक्ति। यह नाम कुरआन में उल्लेखित है और इस्लामी संस्कृति में इसे बहुत धार्मिक और आध्यात्मिक महत्व प्राप्त है। यह नाम सुरक्षा और संरक्षण का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: حذيفه
in_pashto.meaning: حذيفه د محفوظ يا محکم شخص معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: حذيفه د عربي اصلي مذکر نوم دی، چی د محفوظ يا محکم شخص مطلب لري. دا نوم په قرآن کريم کې يادونه شوی دی او په اسلامي کلتور کې يې ډير دينی او روحاني ارزښت لري. دا نوم د حفاظت او محفوظۍ نښه ده.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hudhaifah holds cultural significance in Islamic history for being the name of an esteemed companion of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). Hudhaifah ibn Al-Yaman was known for his unwavering dedication to Islam and was one of the early Muslims who migrated to Medina. He played a prominent role in the early Islamic community, witnessing significant events such as the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah and the Battle of Khaybar. His life and actions serve as an inspiration to Muslims today, demonstrating the importance of loyalty, perseverance, and commitment to the faith.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Hudhaifah carries deep spiritual significance as it is derived from the Arabic root "hudh-d-f," which means "to support," "to help," and "to aid." This root implies a sense of devotion, commitment, and loyalty to Allah. As a spiritual significance, the name Hudhaifah is a constant reminder of the importance of being a devoted servant of Allah and a helper and supporter to others. It encourages individuals to strive towards embodying these qualities in their daily lives, fostering a strong faith, and deepening their connection with the Divine.

historical_references.reference: Hudhaifah ibn Al-Yaman was one of the ten companions who were given the title 'Ashare Muhaddithin' (The Ten Scholars) by Imam Bukhari. He was a close companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and was given the title 'Sword of Allah' due to his bravery in battles. His knowledge of Hadith was recognized even in his own lifetime, and he is recorded to have narrated over six hundred hadiths.
historical_references.time_period: Circa 570 - 650 AD (during the lifetime of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and the early Islamic period).
historical_references.context: Hudhaifah was a prominent scholar and companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), known for his vast knowledge of Hadith and bravery in battles.

historical_references.reference: Hudhaifah ibn Al-Yaman played a significant role in the Battle of Khaybar (628 AD), which marked the last major military campaign of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) before his death. Hudhaifah acted as the Prophet's emissary to negotiate a peace treaty with the Jewish tribe of Khaybar, and the Prophet granted Hudhaifah the land of Khaybar as a reward for his efforts. After the Prophet's death, Hudhaifah continued to be a prominent figure during the early Islamic period, serving as a judge, governor, and scholar.
historical_references.time_period: Circa 628 AD (during the later years of the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) life and the early Islamic period).
historical_references.context: Hudhaifah played a crucial role in the Battle of Khaybar, negotiating a peace treaty and later serving important roles during the early Islamic period.

modern_usage.modern_context: Hudhaifah ibn al-Yaman is a significant figure in Islamic history, often referred to as the 'Sword of Muhammad'. He was a close companion of the Prophet Muhammad, aided in the Battle of Uhud, and later served as a governor and an advisor in Medina. Today, Hudhaifah is remembered and discussed extensively on various platforms, especially in the context of Islamic studies, Muslim history, and education. On Twitter, there are numerous hashtags and threads dedicated to Hudhaifah's life and contributions. On LinkedIn, professional networks and groups may discuss Hudhaifah as a historical figure in leadership and governance. On Reddit, there are communities dedicated to sharing information and knowledge about Hudhaifah and other Islamic figures.
